## Team news

LASK are missing three players as they face one of the toughest games of their European campaign.

Dominik Szoboszlai is a doubt for Liverpool, while the Reds have issues up top with Hugo Ekitike and Alexander Isak expected to miss out.

## Need to know [...] ## Need to know

LASK are not exactly a side with European pedigree, having failed to win a game in the Conference League in their previous European campaign in 2024/25.

Liverpool have to bounce back from their 3-0 loss to Manchester City, but they have collected seven points from three league trips this season.

Score prediction: LASK 1-4 Liverpool (23/2 with LiveScore Bet)
